verdict.rationale: PayPal's Agent Toolkit exposes documented dispute-management tools (list_disputes, get_dispute, accept_dispute_claim) and the standard REST API disputes surface, plus refund tools and durable webhooks for status/outcome notifications, giving developers a real API path to submit/accept dispute outcomes and track status. However this covers only 'accept' resolution — there is no documented endpoint for submitting counter-evidence to contest a dispute, no explicit agent-transaction-specific dispute workflow, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of these tools working end-to-end. Missing for 10: evidence-submission API for contesting disputes (not just accepting), agent-specific dispute handling nuances, and third-party confirmation of the toolkit's dispute functions in practice.
